claim_boundary: This skills-workflow projection contract, its projection-item schema and its synthetic projection items are a schema-level alignment artifact only. Skills and tools are projected from the BACH ControlCenter registry shape (read-only counts, trigger_phrases field, keyword-to-carrier pattern) into an open-ocean contract; no BACH registry row, skill, tool, toolchain or runtime state is exported, migrated or accepted. No live cutover, no BACH runtime change, no working-memory write, no BACH-IN, no migration, no rollback, and no parity acceptance is performed or implied.

hold.rule: Do not modify, push, boot, or wire the BACH ControlCenter registry, any skills or tools row, or any toolchain/workflow state into a live projection during the active hold. Projection items are static, synthetic and temporary; the checker validates shape, uniqueness and toolchain alignment only.

projection.description: Skills, tools and tool patterns from the BACH ControlCenter registry are projected as static open-ocean items carrying German trigger_phrases. Trigger phrases follow the registry skills trigger_phrases field (language de) and the CARRIERS keyword-to-carrier pattern from tools/build_bach_composition_matrix.py. registry-bindings.v1.json documents the exporter and skill_generator pair that would produce such artifacts but stays a skeleton without runtime authority.

projection_signal.description: Each projection item carries a SHA-256 projection_digest fingerprint over the ordered canonical item fields. The digest identifies the projected shape only; it does not encode registry row content.

trigger_uniqueness.description: A trigger phrase may appear in exactly one projection item per projection scope, and a projection_id may map to exactly one item. Carriers and keywords may repeat.

reconciliation.description: All projection items must agree on projection scope and language, and every item must carry at least one trigger phrase. Carriers may differ per item.

workflowhooker.finding: No toolchain or workflow_tuev string exists anywhere in the workflowhooker service; it provides workflow.hook and workflow.check lifecycle hooks only.

toolchain_alignment.verdict: workflow_tuev and toolchain objects are absent from both workflowhooker (0.2.1) and MarbleRun (HEAD 938f3d5, main); the six registry toolchain_runs rows are triggered_by run logs and reference no workflow_tuev chain object in either carrier. Toolchain alignment is therefore recorded as not-present in both carriers, with MarbleRun carrier use for chain, recurring and routine remaining not-evidenced.

skills_workflow_projection.description: Read-only projection of the BACH skills and tools registry shape into open-ocean projection items with German trigger_phrases, aligned against workflowhooker and MarbleRun for toolchain and workflow_tuev presence.
skills_workflow_projection.notes: Projection items are synthetic fingerprints of registry shape; they do not prove real registry row content or live carrier behaviour.
